description:
Real asteroids become cute space animals! Every day, real space rocks fly past Earth, and in Rockimals each one becomes a friendly animal to meet and follow. Made for children aged 6 to 8.

Rockimals turns NASA's live asteroid data into a playful space zoo. A tiny asteroid becomes a Mouse. A giant becomes a Whale.

RADAR IS HOME
Open the app and today's visitors are already circling Earth. Spin the Radar, zoom in and tap a visitor to say hello. Every distance is shown the way children understand it: compared to the Moon.

EIGHT STORYBOOK HEROES
Niko the mouse, Tavi the rabbit, Barney the fox, Kito the tiger, Pofi the bear, Bobo the elephant, Ciko the dino and Enoli the whale each have a five-chapter space adventure. Catch a hero on the Radar to unlock a chapter, then read it in a full-screen picture-book reader. On the title screen and when you meet them, the heroes gently come to life. Chapters you unlock stay yours, and the Library keeps every hero you have met.

MEET EVERY ANIMAL
Each visitor has a name, a size comparison and gentle facts. Is it more like a rabbit or an elephant? How close will it fly? How fast?
Grown-ups can send a friend a space postcard of any animal, behind the parent gate.

PLAY AND DISCOVER
• Earth Shield — guide visitors safely past Earth through colourful levels that show the next reward
• Space Distance Map, Flyby Snap, Space Memory and Size Stack — quick games about size, distance and speed
• Discovery missions and a Space Visitor Journal to collect what you learn
Wrong answers are always met with encouragement — never a buzzer.

MADE FOR iPhone AND iPad
From the Radar to the storybook reader, every screen is designed for both iPhone and iPad.

REAL SCIENCE, GENTLY TOLD
Official NASA designations, distances and speeds live in a "grown-up facts" section behind a parent gate, with links to NASA's own pages for curious families.

ROCKIMALS PLUS (FOR GROWN-UPS)
Radar, animal facts and following animals remain free, along with three minutes of Earth Shield each day and one discovery mission per theme each day. Choose ten free story chapters in total, up to three new chapters per day; these stay yours to replay. Monthly or yearly Rockimals Plus includes the published story library and available English/Turkish narration while active, unlimited Earth Shield, all twelve discovery missions, four more games and journal decorations. Every plan discovers at most one new chapter per animal per day: finish the current chapter, then catch that friend on Radar on a later day. Plus is offered only behind the parent gate. Payment is charged to your Apple Account; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

MADE FOR CHILDREN, BUILT FOR TRUST
• No ads, no accounts, no behavioural analytics, no cross-app tracking
• Purchases, links, postcards and reminders sit behind a parent gate
• Optional story reminders that only a grown-up can switch on
• Works offline with sample sky data, every hero's first chapter and every chapter already downloaded
• Calm motion setting for a slower, gentler screen
• English, Türkçe, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, Français, Deutsch, Español
